Highlights

Scans your video clips (drone, walkthrough, site visit) and keeps only the best shots: sharp, well lit, smooth movement. Builds a reel for you.

Voiceover

Voice comes from

Uses the sound already in your video clips (for example you talking on site) as the voiceover, so you can add captions and voice effects to it. The clips' own sound is muted so it is not heard twice.

Recording plays the video so you can talk over it.

Using Bluetooth headphones? Their mic switches to low-quality call mode and captions struggle. Pick your computer's built-in mic above and keep the headphones for listening. For captions, also set it as the input in your system sound settings (Mac: System Settings, Sound. Windows: Settings, System, Sound).
